name: AFM Environment Reasoning QA 1
description: This is a task to reason about correct actions in solving an agent benchmark problem related to Atomic Force Microscopy Imaging

examples.input:
This is a task from agent benchmark. Perform three sequential high-quality scans of the same 10x10 µm² area using identical scanning parameters (points per line: 128, lines per frame: 128). Set the time per line such that all three scans are completed within 2 min 34 s, and use a scanning mode that minimizes tip damage. For each scan, collect the topographic data and then calculate the root-mean-square roughness.
 Below are few scenarios that may contain correct agent actions

 Scenario A: <thought>The retrieved code snippet provides a template for configuring AFM scan parameters. I need to modify this code to set the scan parameters to 128 points per line, 128 lines per frame, and adjust the scan time per line to ensure all three scans are completed within 2 minutes and 34 seconds. I will calculate the appropriate scan time per line and then execute the code to perform the scans.</thought>
<action>Code_Executor</action>
<action_input>{"code": "
import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# All variables
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.6  # [s] time per line, calculated to fit within 2 min 34 s for three scans

# Start scan
application.StartScan()

# Wait for scan to complete
application.WaitForScanComplete()

# Repeat for three scans
for _ in range(2):
    application.StartScan()
    application.WaitForScanComplete()

del spm
"} </action_input>
